description: A chemist on the corner where Foundry Way meets the Gate Road, with a green cross over the door that flickers on the downstroke and a night hatch beside it with a bell. The window is full of things in boxes that have been in the window long enough to fade on the side facing out, and a card that reads WE DO NOT KEEP CASH OVERNIGHT, WE HAVE NEVER KEPT CASH OVERNIGHT.
name: Dosed & Confused
